name: Emotional Reactivity
description: N — Typical frequency and intensity of distress, emotional reactivity and difficulty coping with pressure.
definition: Typical frequency and intensity of distress, emotional reactivity and difficulty coping with pressure.
indicators_low:
Usually remains emotionally steady.
Experiences fewer worries or frustrations.
Recovers composure relatively readily.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Experiences distress or worry more readily.
Reacts more strongly to setbacks.
Can feel overwhelmed under pressure.
anchor_low: Usually remains emotionally steady.
anchor_high: Experiences distress or worry more readily.
strength_commentary: Lower reactivity can support steadiness; greater sensitivity may bring concerns to attention. Neither end establishes coping skill, mental health status or leadership effectiveness.
development_suggestion: Identify situations that intensify emotional reactions and the responses that help you act constructively.

name: Extraversion
description: E — Typical engagement with social interaction, assertive action, activity, excitement and positive emotion.
definition: Typical engagement with social interaction, assertive action, activity, excitement and positive emotion.
indicators_low:
Often prefers quieter or more solitary settings.
May allow others to initiate interaction.
Can favour a measured pace and lower stimulation.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Often seeks social engagement and stimulation.
Is more inclined to speak up or take the lead.
Can prefer a busy and energetic pace.
anchor_low: Often prefers quieter or more solitary settings.
anchor_high: Often seeks social engagement and stimulation.
strength_commentary: A quieter approach can suit independent concentration; an outgoing approach can suit frequent interaction. Effectiveness depends on the situation and behaviour.
development_suggestion: Consider when to initiate and speak up, and when to listen, slow down or allow space for others.

name: Openness
description: O — Interest in imagination, aesthetics, feelings, unfamiliar experiences, abstract ideas and reconsidering conventional values.
definition: Interest in imagination, aesthetics, feelings, unfamiliar experiences, abstract ideas and reconsidering conventional values.
indicators_low:
Often favours familiar and concrete approaches.
May prefer established routines or views.
Can place less emphasis on abstract or aesthetic exploration.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Often explores ideas, imagination and unfamiliar experiences.
May attend closely to feelings or aesthetics.
Can be more willing to question conventional views.
anchor_low: Often favours familiar and concrete approaches.
anchor_high: Often explores ideas, imagination and unfamiliar experiences.
strength_commentary: Familiar approaches can support continuity; exploration can support discovering alternatives. This domain is not a test of intelligence, creativity performance or adaptability skill.
development_suggestion: Choose where exploration could add value and where an established approach should be retained or tested carefully.

name: Agreeableness
description: A — Typical interpersonal trust, candour, helpfulness, cooperation, modesty and concern for others.
definition: Typical interpersonal trust, candour, helpfulness, cooperation, modesty and concern for others.
indicators_low:
May be more sceptical or guarded with others.
Can place personal interests or direct challenge first.
May take a more self-promoting or emotionally detached approach.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Often gives others the benefit of the doubt.
Is more inclined to help, cooperate and show concern.
May take a modest and accommodating approach.
anchor_low: May be more sceptical or guarded with others.
anchor_high: Often gives others the benefit of the doubt.
strength_commentary: A challenging approach can surface disagreement; a cooperative approach can support relationships. Context determines whether trust, accommodation or challenge is appropriate.
development_suggestion: Consider how to balance care and cooperation with clear boundaries, candid disagreement and appropriate scrutiny.

name: Conscientiousness
description: C — Typical perceived effectiveness, orderliness, commitment, achievement striving, self-discipline and deliberation.
definition: Typical perceived effectiveness, orderliness, commitment, achievement striving, self-discipline and deliberation.
indicators_low:
May prefer a less structured or more spontaneous approach.
Can be less focused on commitments, targets or sustained task effort.
May decide with less advance deliberation.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Often organises work and takes commitments seriously.
Is inclined to pursue goals and persist with tasks.
May think carefully before acting.
anchor_low: May prefer a less structured or more spontaneous approach.
anchor_high: Often organises work and takes commitments seriously.
strength_commentary: Structure and persistence can support follow-through; a less structured style may allow spontaneity. Neither end establishes competence or actual delivery.
development_suggestion: Review whether planning, effort and checking match the task, and where flexibility or a clearer commitment would help.

name: Anxiety
description: N1 — Proneness to worry, fear and anticipatory tension.
definition: Proneness to worry, fear and anticipatory tension.
indicators_low:
Usually worries less.
Feels less threatened by uncertain outcomes.
Reports fewer fears.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Often anticipates what could go wrong.
Experiences worry or tension readily.
Reports more fears.
anchor_low: Usually worries less.
anchor_high: Often anticipates what could go wrong.
strength_commentary: Lower anxiety may make uncertainty easier to tolerate; greater concern can prompt preparation. Neither end establishes risk judgement.
development_suggestion: Distinguish useful preparation from repetitive worry and identify a practical next action.

name: Irritability
description: N2 — Readiness to experience irritation, frustration and anger.
definition: Readiness to experience irritation, frustration and anger.
indicators_low:
Is usually difficult to irritate.
Reports less frequent anger.
Often tolerates frustrations calmly.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Becomes irritated readily.
May experience anger when frustrated.
Can react strongly to perceived provocation.
anchor_low: Is usually difficult to irritate.
strength_commentary: Lower anger can support calm exchanges; anger can signal that a boundary or concern needs attention. The expression and consequences of anger require separate evidence.
development_suggestion: Notice early signs of irritation and choose how to express a concern without escalating the exchange.

name: Discouragement
description: N3 — Tendency to experience low mood, discouragement and negative feelings about oneself, as represented by these personality items.
definition: Tendency to experience low mood, discouragement and negative feelings about oneself, as represented by these personality items.
indicators_low:
Reports fewer periods of feeling down.
Usually feels more comfortable with oneself.
Is less prone to discouragement.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
More often feels down or discouraged.
May evaluate oneself negatively.
Reports less comfort with oneself.
anchor_low: Reports fewer periods of feeling down.
anchor_high: More often feels down or discouraged.
strength_commentary: This is a personality facet score, not a diagnosis or a measure of clinical severity. Interpret experiences in context rather than labelling capability.
development_suggestion: Reflect on situations associated with discouragement and the support, routines or adjustments that are helpful.

name: Social Confidence
description: N4 — Reported comfort approaching others, receiving social attention and handling unfamiliar or difficult social situations.
definition: Reported comfort approaching others, receiving social attention and handling unfamiliar or difficult social situations.
indicators_low:
May hesitate to approach others.
Prefers to avoid drawing attention.
Feels less comfortable in unfamiliar social situations.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Is less troubled by social attention.
Approaches unfamiliar people more readily.
Feels less constrained by possible embarrassment.
anchor_low: May hesitate to approach others.
anchor_high: Is less troubled by social attention.
strength_commentary: Lower discomfort can make public participation easier; greater sensitivity may encourage preparation. This facet does not measure self-awareness or insight.
development_suggestion: Identify a manageable way to participate in situations where attention or unfamiliarity feels uncomfortable.

name: Indulgence
description: N5 — Difficulty resisting cravings, temptations and urges to overindulge.
definition: Difficulty resisting cravings, temptations and urges to overindulge.
indicators_low:
Finds temptations easier to resist.
Usually regulates indulgence.
Reports more control over cravings.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Finds strong cravings harder to resist.
May overindulge.
Reports difficulty limiting tempting activities.
anchor_low: Finds temptations easier to resist.
anchor_high: Finds strong cravings harder to resist.
strength_commentary: The content concerns regulation of appetites and indulgence. It should not be treated as a comprehensive measure of impulsive decision-making.
development_suggestion: Identify tempting situations and decide in advance what limits or routines would be useful.

name: Stress Tolerance
description: N6 — Reported tendency to remain calm and feel able to cope under pressure rather than become overwhelmed.
definition: Reported tendency to remain calm and feel able to cope under pressure rather than become overwhelmed.
indicators_low:
Can become overwhelmed by events.
May panic under pressure.
Can feel unable to deal with demands.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Usually feels able to cope under pressure.
Maintains composure during difficult events.
Is less readily overwhelmed.
anchor_low: Can become overwhelmed by events.
anchor_high: Usually feels able to cope under pressure.
strength_commentary: Lower vulnerability reflects reported steadiness under stress; it does not demonstrate coping skill or recovery from adversity. Greater vulnerability can highlight situations that need support.
development_suggestion: Identify demands that become overwhelming and the practical supports or actions that help restore control.

name: Friendliness
description: E1 — Warmth and ease in approaching and engaging with other people.
definition: Warmth and ease in approaching and engaging with other people.
indicators_low:
Maintains more interpersonal distance.
May be slow to approach new people.
Can prefer a more reserved manner.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Makes friends readily.
Feels comfortable around people.
Often engages with warmth.
anchor_low: Maintains more interpersonal distance.
strength_commentary: A reserved approach can preserve boundaries; warmth can make contact easier. Relationship effectiveness still depends on behaviour and context.
development_suggestion: Choose when to initiate contact and when to respect personal or professional distance.

name: Sociability
description: E2 — Preference for company, crowds and frequent social interaction rather than solitude.
definition: Preference for company, crowds and frequent social interaction rather than solitude.
indicators_low:
Often prefers solitude or smaller settings.
May avoid crowds.
Needs less frequent social contact.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Enjoys being around many people.
Often seeks group interaction.
Is comfortable with crowded social settings.
anchor_low: Often prefers solitude or smaller settings.
strength_commentary: Solitude can support concentration and recovery; company can provide stimulation and connection. Neither preference establishes teamwork skill.
development_suggestion: Plan a workable balance between social contact and quieter time.

name: Assertiveness
description: E3 — Inclination to take charge, express direction and assume a leading role.
definition: Inclination to take charge, express direction and assume a leading role.
indicators_low:
Often lets others lead.
May be less inclined to take control.
Can prefer a less directive role.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Readily takes charge.
Is inclined to lead others.
Often seeks control of group action.
anchor_low: Often lets others lead.
strength_commentary: Taking charge can help a group act; allowing others to lead can support participation. More assertiveness does not automatically produce more effective leadership.
development_suggestion: Consider when clear direction is needed and when to invite input or share control.

name: Activity Level
description: E4 — Preference for a busy, active and fast-moving pace of life.
definition: Preference for a busy, active and fast-moving pace of life.
indicators_low:
Often prefers a leisurely pace.
Allows more downtime.
May avoid keeping continuously busy.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Often stays busy.
Prefers frequent activity.
May maintain a demanding pace.
anchor_low: Often prefers a leisurely pace.
strength_commentary: A measured pace can allow reflection and recovery; activity can support engagement with a busy environment. This facet does not establish productivity.
development_suggestion: Check whether your pace matches the task and whether adequate recovery or momentum is needed.

name: Excitement-Seeking
description: E5 — Appetite for excitement, adventure and stimulating or potentially reckless experiences.
definition: Appetite for excitement, adventure and stimulating or potentially reckless experiences.
indicators_low:
Prefers lower stimulation.
May avoid adventurous situations.
Usually has less appetite for excitement.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Seeks excitement and adventure.
Enjoys strong stimulation.
May be attracted to reckless experiences.
anchor_low: Prefers lower stimulation.
strength_commentary: Lower stimulation can suit predictable settings; excitement can make stimulating settings appealing. This facet does not establish the quality of risk decisions.
development_suggestion: Distinguish the appeal of excitement from the benefits and consequences of a particular action.

name: Cheerfulness
description: E6 — Frequency and expression of positive emotion, enjoyment and enthusiasm.
definition: Frequency and expression of positive emotion, enjoyment and enthusiasm.
indicators_low:
Expresses less visible joy.
May experience positive emotion less frequently.
Can take a more subdued emotional tone.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Often feels and expresses joy.
Readily finds enjoyment.
Can take an enthusiastic or positive tone.
anchor_low: Expresses less visible joy.
strength_commentary: A subdued style need not indicate distress; cheerfulness can make positive engagement visible. Neither end alone establishes realism or performance.
development_suggestion: Consider how your emotional expression affects others and when a realistic concern should also be voiced.

name: Imagination
description: O1 — Interest in fantasy, daydreaming and a vivid inner imaginative life.
definition: Interest in fantasy, daydreaming and a vivid inner imaginative life.
indicators_low:
Focuses more on concrete experience.
Spends less time daydreaming.
May have less interest in fantasy.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Enjoys vivid imagination.
Often daydreams.
Can become absorbed in fantasy or thought.
anchor_low: Focuses more on concrete experience.
strength_commentary: Concrete attention can support practical focus; imagination can provide possibilities. This facet is not a test of creative problem-solving performance.
development_suggestion: Choose when imaginative exploration is useful and how to connect possibilities with practical action.

name: Artistic Interests
description: O2 — Interest in art, poetry, beauty and aesthetic experience.
definition: Interest in art, poetry, beauty and aesthetic experience.
indicators_low:
Has less interest in artistic activities.
May give aesthetics less attention.
Often prefers other forms of engagement.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Values artistic experience.
Notices beauty.
May enjoy art, poetry or museums.
anchor_low: Has less interest in artistic activities.
strength_commentary: Different levels of artistic interest reflect preferences rather than artistic skill or leadership capability.
development_suggestion: Consider whether aesthetic experiences add enjoyment or perspective without treating them as a performance requirement.

name: Emotional Sensitivity
description: O3 — Attention to, intensity of and interest in emotional experience.
definition: Attention to, intensity of and interest in emotional experience.
indicators_low:
Pays less attention to emotional reactions.
May experience feelings less intensely.
Can find emotional expression harder to relate to.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Experiences feelings intensely.
Notices emotional responses.
Often attends to others' emotions.
anchor_low: Pays less attention to emotional reactions.
strength_commentary: Lower emotional emphasis can support emotional distance; stronger emotional experience can bring feelings into awareness. This facet does not establish emotion-reading accuracy or emotional intelligence.
development_suggestion: Notice relevant feelings while checking interpretations of other people's emotions through conversation.

name: Variety Seeking
description: O4 — Preference for variety and unfamiliar experiences rather than familiar routines and conventional ways.
definition: Preference for variety and unfamiliar experiences rather than familiar routines and conventional ways.
indicators_low:
Often favours familiar approaches.
Prefers established routines.
May dislike changes to known ways.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Enjoys variety.
Is more open to unfamiliar experiences.
May be less attached to conventional routines.
anchor_low: Often favours familiar approaches.
strength_commentary: Familiarity can support continuity; variety can support exploration. Preference for change is different from effective adaptation to change.
development_suggestion: Decide where trying something unfamiliar is worthwhile and what preparation or continuity is needed.

name: Intellectual Curiosity
description: O5 — Interest in abstract ideas, challenging material and theoretical or philosophical discussion.
definition: Interest in abstract ideas, challenging material and theoretical or philosophical discussion.
indicators_low:
Often prefers concrete or practical material.
Has less interest in theoretical discussion.
May find abstract ideas less appealing.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Enjoys challenging reading.
Is interested in abstract ideas.
Often engages with theory or philosophy.
anchor_low: Often prefers concrete or practical material.
strength_commentary: Concrete and abstract interests can each suit different work. This is a self-report personality facet, not an intelligence or reasoning test.
development_suggestion: Match the level of abstraction to the problem and seek evidence that ideas can explain or improve something useful.

name: Liberalism
description: O6 — Willingness to question conventional social values, as operationalised here using political and moral-attitude items.
definition: Willingness to question conventional social values, as operationalised here using political and moral-attitude items.
indicators_low:
More often endorses conventional or conservative views.
May favour established social rules.
Can prefer firmer moral boundaries.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
More often endorses liberal political views.
May question absolute moral rules.
Can be more willing to reconsider conventions.
anchor_low: More often endorses conventional or conservative views.
anchor_high: More often endorses liberal political views.
strength_commentary: The original English items concern political and moral attitudes. This facet does not establish leadership quality, fairness, learning agility or organisational suitability.
development_suggestion: Discuss the meaning of differing views without treating a political preference as a capability score.

name: Trust
description: A1 — Readiness to believe that other people are honest, well-intentioned and dependable.
definition: Readiness to believe that other people are honest, well-intentioned and dependable.
indicators_low:
Is more sceptical of others' intentions.
May verify claims before relying on them.
Can be guarded in extending trust.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Gives others the benefit of the doubt.
Often assumes good intentions.
Readily believes what others say.
anchor_low: Is more sceptical of others' intentions.
anchor_high: Gives others the benefit of the doubt.
strength_commentary: Scrutiny can protect against misplaced trust; trust can make cooperation easier. The appropriate balance depends on evidence and consequences.
development_suggestion: Choose how much trust to extend and what verification is proportionate to the situation.

name: Fairness
description: A2 — Reported avoidance of cheating, manipulating, exploiting or obstructing other people. This does not establish impartiality, justice or verified ethical conduct.
definition: Reported avoidance of cheating, manipulating, exploiting or obstructing other people. This does not establish impartiality, justice or verified ethical conduct.
indicators_low:
May endorse more instrumental treatment of others.
Can be more willing to gain advantage at others' expense.
May report obstructive or exploitative behaviour.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Reports avoiding exploitation or cheating.
Is less inclined to manipulate others for gain.
Usually rejects obstructing others for personal advantage.
anchor_low: May endorse more instrumental treatment of others.
strength_commentary: The retained scale label is Morality. These self-reports are not verification of integrity, ethical conduct or honesty-humility.
development_suggestion: Examine concrete decisions and their effects on other people rather than treating the label as a character verdict.

name: Helpfulness
description: A3 — Inclination to care about other people's needs and offer practical help.
definition: Inclination to care about other people's needs and offer practical help.
indicators_low:
May give others' needs less attention.
Is less inclined to spend time helping.
Can prefer clearer boundaries around assistance.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Often offers help.
Shows concern for others.
Is willing to spend time supporting people.
anchor_low: May give others' needs less attention.
strength_commentary: Boundaries can protect capacity; helping can support others. Effective support requires attention to what help is needed and what is sustainable.
development_suggestion: Balance useful assistance with clear priorities, consent and sustainable boundaries.

name: Cooperation
description: A4 — Inclination to avoid interpersonal aggression, retaliation and unnecessary conflict.
definition: Inclination to avoid interpersonal aggression, retaliation and unnecessary conflict.
indicators_low:
May be more confrontational.
Can respond to conflict with hostility.
May be inclined to retaliate.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Is less inclined to insult or retaliate.
Often avoids aggressive exchanges.
Can prefer an accommodating approach.
anchor_low: May be more confrontational.
anchor_high: Is less inclined to insult or retaliate.
strength_commentary: A cooperative approach can reduce friction. Constructive disagreement and assertive boundaries should be distinguished from the aggression represented by the lower end.
development_suggestion: Raise disagreements directly while avoiding insults, revenge or unnecessary escalation.

name: Modesty
description: A5 — Restraint in claiming superiority, praising oneself or drawing attention to one's virtues.
definition: Restraint in claiming superiority, praising oneself or drawing attention to one's virtues.
indicators_low:
Readily expresses a high opinion of oneself.
May emphasise personal virtues.
Can make superiority claims.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Avoids claiming superiority.
Is less inclined to boast.
May downplay personal virtues.
anchor_low: Readily expresses a high opinion of oneself.
strength_commentary: Visible self-advocacy can communicate achievements; modesty can leave room for others. This facet does not establish accurate self-insight or confidence.
development_suggestion: Describe achievements with evidence while recognising the contributions and strengths of others.

name: Compassion
description: A6 — Compassion and concern for people experiencing hardship or disadvantage.
definition: Compassion and concern for people experiencing hardship or disadvantage.
indicators_low:
Maintains more distance from others' difficulties.
May give hardship less attention.
Can prefer to avoid distressing concerns.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Feels concern for people facing hardship.
Responds with compassion.
Often attends to others' difficulties.
anchor_low: Maintains more distance from others' difficulties.
anchor_high: Feels concern for people facing hardship.
strength_commentary: Emotional distance can help maintain boundaries; compassion can draw attention to unmet needs. Neither alone establishes sound decisions or effective assistance.
development_suggestion: Consider others' needs alongside evidence, fairness and the practical consequences of a response.

name: Perceived Competence
description: C1 — Belief in one's effectiveness at completing tasks and handling practical demands. This is perceived competence, not independently demonstrated ability.
definition: Belief in one's effectiveness at completing tasks and handling practical demands. This is perceived competence, not independently demonstrated ability.
indicators_low:
Reports less confidence in task effectiveness.
May doubt how well tasks will be handled.
Can feel less certain about getting things done.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Reports confidence in completing tasks.
Feels able to handle demands.
Usually expects to know how to get things done.
anchor_low: Reports less confidence in task effectiveness.
strength_commentary: Confidence can support willingness to act; doubt can encourage checking or assistance. This facet measures perceived effectiveness rather than demonstrated competence.
development_suggestion: Compare confidence with task evidence and identify where practice, feedback or help would improve calibration.

name: Orderliness
description: C2 — Preference for tidiness, organisation and returning belongings to their proper place.
definition: Preference for tidiness, organisation and returning belongings to their proper place.
indicators_low:
Is less concerned with tidiness.
May leave belongings out of place.
Can prefer a less orderly environment.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Usually keeps things tidy.
Returns belongings to their place.
Prefers an orderly environment.
anchor_low: Is less concerned with tidiness.
strength_commentary: An orderly environment can make retrieval and routines easier; less concern with tidiness may suit some flexible settings. This facet does not establish planning or management skill.
development_suggestion: Use enough structure to make work manageable without adding organisation that serves little purpose.

name: Dependability
description: C3 — Reported commitment to promises, truthfulness and following rules.
definition: Reported commitment to promises, truthfulness and following rules.
indicators_low:
May treat commitments or rules more flexibly.
Can report breaking promises.
May be less consistent about truthfulness.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Usually reports keeping promises.
Takes rules and commitments seriously.
Endorses telling the truth.
anchor_low: May treat commitments or rules more flexibly.
strength_commentary: Commitment can support reliability. Whether a rule should be followed or challenged requires judgement beyond this self-report facet.
development_suggestion: Make commitments explicitly, raise difficulties early and explain any necessary challenge to an inappropriate rule.

name: Achievement Striving
description: C4 — Willingness to work hard, exceed requirements and invest effort in achievement.
definition: Willingness to work hard, exceed requirements and invest effort in achievement.
indicators_low:
May be satisfied with meeting minimum requirements.
Often invests less additional effort.
Can place less emphasis on demanding achievement.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Often works hard.
Tries to exceed expectations.
Invests effort in achieving more.
anchor_low: May be satisfied with meeting minimum requirements.
strength_commentary: A measured level of striving can protect other priorities; strong striving can sustain demanding goals. Actual outcomes and the value of the goals require separate evidence.
development_suggestion: Choose goals deliberately and check that effort remains proportionate to priorities and available capacity.

name: Self-Discipline
description: C5 — Inclination to start tasks, stay prepared and carry plans through rather than delay or waste time.
definition: Inclination to start tasks, stay prepared and carry plans through rather than delay or waste time.
indicators_low:
May delay starting tasks.
Can find follow-through difficult.
May spend time on competing distractions.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Often starts tasks readily.
Prepares for what needs doing.
Usually carries out plans.
anchor_low: May delay starting tasks.
strength_commentary: Sustained task focus can support completion; willingness to pause can sometimes allow reprioritisation. The facet does not establish whether a task should be continued.
development_suggestion: Identify the next useful action and review whether persistence or a deliberate change of plan is needed.

name: Deliberation
description: C6 — Tendency to deliberate before acting rather than rush into decisions.
definition: Tendency to deliberate before acting rather than rush into decisions.
indicators_low:
May act quickly with limited advance thought.
Can make spontaneous decisions.
May rush into action.
indicators_mid: Expression can vary by context; examine examples of both ends. This text does not define a population-average band.
indicators_high:
Usually thinks before acting.
Is less inclined to make rash decisions.
Often considers actions in advance.
anchor_low: May act quickly with limited advance thought.
strength_commentary: Speed can matter when action is urgent; deliberation can help examine consequences. Neither end establishes decision quality or an appropriate appetite for risk.
development_suggestion: Match the amount of deliberation to the stakes, time available and reversibility of the decision.
